tasks.title: Learn OOP
tasks.description: Deep dive into the four main principles of Object-Oriented Programming: Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, and Abstraction. Implement each principle in a practical project.

tasks.title: Learn SOLID principles
tasks.description: Study and apply the five SOLID principles of object-oriented design: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion.

tasks.title: Learn Design Patterns
tasks.description: Learn common creational, structural, and behavioral design patterns (e.g., Factory, Singleton, Observer). Read the 'Gang of Four' book and implement three patterns.

tasks.title: Learn TypeScript
tasks.description: Master TypeScript fundamentals, including static typing, interfaces, generics, and enums. Set up a new project with a strict tsconfig.json file.

tasks.title: Learn JavaScript
tasks.description: Review modern JavaScript features (ES6+), including arrow functions, Promises, async/await, destructuring, and modules. Build a small asynchronous application.

tasks.title: Learn React
tasks.description: Explore the core concepts of React, including components, props, state, and hooks like useState, useEffect, and useContext. Build a single-page application (SPA).

tasks.title: Learn Node.js
tasks.description: Understand the Node.js runtime, its event loop, and asynchronous nature. Build a command-line application that interacts with the file system.

tasks.title: Learn Express
tasks.description: Create a RESTful API using the Express.js framework. Implement routing, middleware for authentication/logging, and handle different HTTP methods.

tasks.title: Learn MongoDB
tasks.description: Learn the fundamentals of NoSQL databases with MongoDB. Understand collections and documents. Use Mongoose as an ODM to define schemas and models.

tasks.title: Learn Docker
tasks.description: Get started with containerization. Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js application, build a Docker image, and run it as a container.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests with Jest
tasks.description: Set up the Jest testing framework. Write unit tests for several functions and React components, aiming for at least 80% test coverage.

tasks.title: Set up CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Configure a basic Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions to automatically run tests and build the project.

tasks.title: Refactor CSS with a Preprocessor
tasks.description: Learn the basics of a CSS preprocessor like Sass/SCSS. Refactor an existing project's CSS to use variables, nesting, and mixins.

tasks.title: Learn Kubernetes
tasks.description: Understand the basics of container orchestration with Kubernetes. Learn about Pods, Services, and Deployments in a local cluster like Minikube.

tasks.title: Improve Application Accessibility (a11y)
tasks.description: Audit a web application for accessibility issues. Use tools like Lighthouse and screen readers to identify and fix problems. Implement ARIA attributes and ensure keyboard navigation.
